400 kHz is the SCD4x maximum. Drop to 50000 on long wiring.
The SCD4x corrects CO2 for air pressure. A wrong value biases every reading.
ASC assumes the sensor sees fresh air weekly. In a sealed chamber it does not, so leave this on.
